claims.statement: Leonardo advises the Florentine government on diverting the Arno to cut off Pisa. Niccolò Machiavelli was involved on the government side. The works failed in 1504.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Florentine government correspondence.
